normalization.efficiency: Selected rows omit NBT_EFFICIENCY; MultiTileEntityBasicMachine defaults mEfficiency to 10000.
normalization.parallel_duration: Each variant records its source NBT_PARALLEL_DURATION value; T12 centrifuge/sifter/electrolyzer, T16b press and all selected T17a Heat_T rows are true, while T16a lathe/rolling mill/wiremill/shredder rows are false.
normalization.overclock: The 24 pre-T17 rows use standard overclocking. The ten selected T17a Distillery, Dryer, Melter and Smelter Heat_T rows explicitly use cheap overclocking.
normalization.controller_profile: Large Centrifuge declares NBT_INPUT_MIN=512, NBT_INPUT_MAX=4096, NBT_EFFICIENCY=5000 and NBT_PARALLEL=16; the pinned T12a source projection fixes nominal input at 512, capacity at 4096, RU identity, CHEAP overclocking and parallel-duration behavior.
